subject: LucentAI technical deep-dive — scheduling and agenda
messages:
From: Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@lucentai.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv@lucentai.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery — technical deep-dive request

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the discovery call today — Rajiv and I walked away with a good sense of Redwood's runtime and how it might map to LucentAI's inference patterns. Our infra team would like to dig into the technical details before we move to procurement. Can we set up a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive next week to cover:

- latency profiles and expected p95 at 2k qps
- network connectivity options (VPC peering, private endpoints)
- data handling and KV cache behavior for streaming workloads
- model variant fallback and rollout policies

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Wed 6/14: 9:30–11:00 or 2:00–3:30
- Thu 6/15: 10:00–11:30

I attached our discovery notes (lucentai_discovery_notes.pdf) and a short environment summary.

Would appreciate a confirmation of attendees (our side: Rajiv + 2 infra engineers) and a proposed agenda.

Thanks,
Alyssa
Head of Platform
LucentAI
(attachment: lucentai_discovery_notes.pdf (application/pdf))

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@lucentai.com>, Rajiv Singh <rajiv@lucentai.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery — technical deep-dive request

Hi Alyssa — great to hear, glad the discovery was useful.

We can do either slot but recommend 90 minutes for the full runbook + Q&A. Proposed agenda (90m):
1) 10m — intros & objectives
2) 25m — runtime architecture & kernel choices (latency/cost tradeoffs)
3) 20m — connectivity, VPC/private deployment options, and security controls
4) 20m — deployment patterns: canaries, rollbacks, model variants, KV cache behavior
5) 15m — open Q&A + next steps (pricing/PO/procurement lane)

Available slots (PDT):
- Wed 6/14 14:00–15:30 (slot A)
- Thu 6/15 10:00–11:30 (slot B)

Soojin will cover connectivity and private deployment; Ben will take model rollout and runtime questions. Will you and Rajiv be able to share the names/emails of the infra folks (for calendar invites)?

I can send a calendar invite with a preliminary agenda + a short pre-read (redwood_arch_checklist.xlsx). Alternate: if you prefer a shorter 60m session, we can compress the agenda and focus on the three most critical topics — let me know.

Calendar link for convenience: https://calendly.com/redwood/tech-deep-dive?cid=LUC-2028-0421

Best,
Jordan
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood_arch_checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet))

Adding a quick note — I can take the Thu 6/15 10:00–11:30 slot (slot B) if that works for Lucent. I'll bring the private deployment checklist and a short runbook for peering and private endpoints.

Ben — can you bring the KV-cache + fallback examples (small slides) and the p95 numbers from our benchmark set?
